title: Horizontal composition of ordinary derived base-change maps
statement: Choose the derived categories of module sheaves on schemes [def-pc-derived-category,def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let f:X→Y, g:S→Y, h:T→S, p:P→X, q:P→S, t:I→P, r:I→T satisfy p≫f=q≫g and t≫q=r≫h. Let c be the pinned composition family for derived pullbacks [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] and β the pinned ordinary base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For every E in D(X), Lh(β(f,q,g,p)_E) followed by β(q,r,h,t) at Lp(E) equals c(h,g) at Rf(E), followed by β(f,r,h≫g,t≫p)_E, followed by Rr(c(t,p) inverse at E). The outer commutativity equality follows from the two square equalities. No cartesian, quasi-coherent, finiteness, or invertibility assumption is needed.

source.place: Remark 20.28.5 (composition of base-change maps); Remark 20.28.3, Tag 08HY (counit definition); Lemma 20.27.2, Tag 0D5S (pullback associativity)

proof.text: Transpose both sides under the pinned adjunction for r. Apply naturality of its Hom equivalence on both sides. Naturality of c(r,h), equality transport for t≫q=r≫h, and naturality of c(t,q) move the first base-change map through the comparison defining the second. Pullback of this first map followed by the q counit is its defining transpose, by the inverse Hom equivalence. This gives c(r,h), the equality transport, c(t,q) inverse, followed by Lt of the first transpose.

Evaluate pullback associativity at Rf(E) for triples (t,q,g), (r,h,g), and (t,p,f). Naturality of c in the two square equalities gives the equality-transport identities. Cancel by Lt of c(p,f), followed by c(t,p≫f). Apply the three associativity equalities and cancel inverse/hom factors. The remaining equality transports coincide by proof irrelevance. Naturality of c(t,p) inverse moves the f counit to the end. Injectivity of the r Hom equivalence gives the stated identity. All steps are categorical identities, so empty schemes, zero objects and identity arrows are covered.

proof_origin.note: Explicit adjunction verification of the identity whose verification is omitted in Remark 20.28.5.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeDerivedBaseChange_horizontal_pasting
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y P S I T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : S ⟶ Y) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (p : P ⟶ X) (q : P ⟶ S) (t : I ⟶ P) (r : I ⟶ T)
    (hs : p ≫ f = q ≫ g) (hi : t ≫ q = r ≫ h) :
    let c := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
    ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback h).map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f q g p hs E) ≫
          schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap q r h t hi ((derivedPullback p).obj E) =
        (c h g).hom.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ≫
          schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f r (h ≫ g) (t ≫ p)
            (by rw [Category.assoc, hs, ← Category.assoc t q g, hi, Category.assoc]) E ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage r).map ((c t p).inv.app E)
